The extreme danger attending this fubflance when ta-
ken into the human body, arises from its infolubility,
and the difficulty of decompounding it; for there can

cure, because any alkaline fubflance will certainly dec-

Arfenic, on the contrary, cannot be decompounded,

a short time as the exigence of the cafe we speak of

It therefore remains in the flomach, continually exerting its milchievous qualities, unlefs it can be dichar-
ged by vomiting.<x_0.7998><y_0.6672><class_Text>
